property_summary: After a successful initialize(_accessControl) on a proxy, any access-gated call (setSlopes with kink in (0,1e27)) must succeed when the configured access manager grants access; the mutant never stores the manager (address 0), so the checkAccess call fails and setSlopes reverts.
change_summary: Remove the __Access_init(_accessControl) call so the accessControl address is never set during initialization.
